description: Use this when: you have written facts about one notice (마감, 추정가격, 배정예산, 계약 방법, 낙찰하한율, 참가 지역, 필요한 면허) and want to check them before answering. Returns 맞음 / 틀림 / 기록 없음 per claim with the recorded value and its source field. Do not use this when: you have not read the notice yet (use get_notice).
